headline: Barcelona lowers the tax on cruise passengers making a stopover: by 2030 they will pay 30 euros to dock in the city
summary: Barcelona has approved a lower tax on cruise passengers making a stopover, with fees reaching 30 euros by 2030. The city also froze the hostel surcharge and rejected a hotel IBI property tax increase.
why: Cruise and tourism taxes affect port revenues, cruise operators and the city's tourism economy, which is a major driver of Spain's services sector.
